title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer
Up to £85,000

This is an opportunity to join a well-established, multi-site organisation that is continuing to invest in its data and technology function. With a growing emphasis on data-driven decision making, the business is undertaking an exciting journey to modernise its data estate and build scalable data solutions that support both operational and strategic objectives.

As a Data Engineer, you will play a key role in the development and maintenance of the company's cloud-based data platform. Working across the full data lifecycle, you will help design and deliver robust data pipelines, optimise data processes and ensure stakeholders have access to trusted, high-quality information.

You will work closely with teams across the business to understand requirements and deliver solutions that enhance reporting, analytics and business insight capabilities. This is a hands-on role that offers the opportunity to influence the future direction of the data platform while working with modern technologies and best-practice engineering principles.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build and maintain scalable data pipelines and data models within a modern cloud-based data platform.
  • Develop and optimise ELT/ETL processes to support reporting, analytics and business intelligence requirements.
  • Build and maintain solutions within Snowflake, ensuring performance, scalability and reliability.
  • Implement and support Medallion Architecture principles to create structured, trusted and reusable data assets.
  • Write and optimise complex SQL queries, views and transformations.
  • Develop Python-based processes to support data ingestion and transformation.
  • Work closely with business stakeholders to understand data requirements and translate them into technical solutions.

Skills & Experience

  • Previous experience in a Data Engineer or similar data-focused role.
  • Strong commercial experience working with Snowflake.
  • Experience designing and implementing solutions using Medallion Architecture principles.
  • Advanced SQL development and query-writing skills.
  • Strong Python programming experience for data engineering and automation tasks.
  • Experience developing and maintaining ETL/ELT processes and data pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of data modelling and data warehousing concepts.

What's On Offer?

  • Opportunity to join a successful and growing organisation investing in data and technology.
  • Base salary of up to £85,000
  • The chance to play a key role in shaping the future of the company's data platform.
  • Exposure to a broad range of stakeholders across multiple business functions.
  • A collaborative and supportive technology team.
  • Strong opportunities for professional development and career progression.
  • Hybrid working environment based in the Windsor office.
  • The opportunity to directly influence reporting, analytics and business decision-making.
